about: The page a design opens on where it was left (LastPlace.pageIndex), on both phones. pages: the design's page ids in order, hidden: those hidden, left: the page id kept, opens: the page index it opens on - that page when it is there and shown; when it is hidden, the nearest shown page before it, else the nearest after it, else (every page hidden) the page itself; when it is gone, the first shown page, else the first.
